HACKATHON GUARDRAILS (non-negotiable):
- DEADLINE: 2026-10-12T18:25Z. Feature freeze 2026-10-12T06:25Z. You work on ONE task; stop when its acceptance passes.
- Read docs/DESIGN.md sections named in your task before writing code. src/types.ts is the shared contract:
  if you need a change, make it minimal and say so in your final message.
- Touch only the files your task OWNS. Never edit another task's files, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, setups/, experiments/.
- Tests: `bun test <your test path>` must pass and `bun test` (whole suite) must not regress. Never modify existing tests
  unless your task says so. Fixtures are built by scripts from real samples, never hand-invented payloads.
- Commit in small steps as work lands, message prefix "<task id>: ". Never rewrite history. Never commit secrets or .env.
- Never describe unbuilt work as done in README/docs. No numbers in docs except those generated into docs/FACTS.md.
- Use `entire graph impact --symbol <name> --json` (or `entire graph query`) before editing an existing module, if available.
- Final message: what you built, test output summary, any types.ts change, anything you could not finish.
- Never start a command in the background or wait for a notification: this session ends when you stop. Run tests and builds in the foreground, then commit.

TASK T84 · W4 · The book finds the promoted setup in the review
GOAL: scripts/book-self.ts says "promoted setup E has no sessions in this review", but the review has 40 sessions labelled "Claude Code ·
deepseek-flash", which is setup E (setups/candidates/E.json). Review setups are hashed ids, and the promotion names a definition id. Map
one to the other, so the hire-vs-scale scenario gets E's measured rates.
READ: scripts/book-self.ts (promotedOf), src/setups/registry.ts (loadSetups), src/agent/backend.ts (resolveSetup: tags, then
harness+model+rules), reports/rajkaria__roster/review.json (setups, tags), reports/self/review-1/promotion.json, setups/candidates/E.json.
OWNS: scripts/book-self.ts, tests/book-self-promoted.test.ts
BUILD: Resolve the promoted definition id to a review setup in this order: (1) the review's prompt-tag map; (2) the setup whose model
matches the definition's model (for E: deepseek-flash) and whose harness matches; (3) otherwise keep the current note. When resolved,
compute the scale scenario from that setup's measured cost per session and surviving-changes rate. Record which rule matched in book.json
(`promoted.matchedBy`).
ACCEPTANCE: tests with a fixture review and E.json: E resolves by model to the deepseek-flash setup and the scenario is non-null;
unmatched keeps the note. Run `bun scripts/book-self.ts` and commit the regenerated reports/self/book.json.
TEST: bun test tests/book-self-promoted.test.ts && bun run typecheck
DO NOT TOUCH: anything outside OWNS.
